document_rules.name: Embedded System Prompt
document_rules.pattern: (?i)(system prompt|ignore previous|you are now|as an ai assistant|pretend you are|forget instructions|output the system prompt|jailbreak|do anything now|bypass safety|override directives)
document_rules.description: Document contains phrases that may try to override the model's behavior.

document_rules.name: Base64 Encoded Content
document_rules.description: Long base64 string possibly hiding malicious payload.

document_rules.name: Zero-Width Characters
document_rules.description: Zero-width characters can be used for steganography.

document_rules.name: HTML/Script Injection
document_rules.description: HTML tags with event handlers or script execution.

document_rules.name: Null Byte Injection
document_rules.description: Null bytes can be used for truncation attacks.

document_rules.name: XML/XXE Injection
document_rules.description: XML external entity or CDATA injection attempts.

document_rules.name: Markdown Injection
document_rules.description: Markdown links with javascript or data URIs.

document_rules.name: Path Traversal
document_rules.description: Path traversal attempts to access system files.

document_rules.name: YAML/JSON Injection
document_rules.description: YAML/JSON injection for code execution or NoSQL injection.

document_rules.name: Data URI Injection
document_rules.description: Data URIs that may contain malicious content.

document_rules.name: Right-to-Left Override
document_rules.description: RTL override characters used to hide malicious content.

document_rules.name: Control Character Injection
document_rules.description: Control characters (except tab/newline) that may be used for attacks.

document_rules.name: Excessive Repetition (DoS)
document_rules.description: Excessive repetition that may cause tokenization bombs.

query_rules.name: Direct Prompt Injection
query_rules.pattern: (?i)(ignore previous|forget instructions|output the system prompt|you are now|jailbreak|do anything now|system prompt|admin password|sudo|rm -rf|drop table|override|bypass|compromise|break rules|break safety|act as|pretend you are)
